story_info.title: Max Monkey's Glow-Berry Quest
story_info.subtitle: A brave climb for a special treat.
story_info.moral: Being brave helps you do amazing things.

main_character.name: Max Monkey
main_character.appearance: Max is a small, energetic monkey with soft brown fur, a lighter tan face and belly, big curious eyes, and a long curling tail. He has an eager, wide-open smile.

slides.title: A Sparkly Surprise
slides.text: Max Monkey loved Adventure Jungle. "Adventure is waiting!" he said with a happy jump. Today, he heard about a special treat. They were called Glow-Berries. They grew only on the tallest trees. Max wanted to find one very much. It would be a super exciting quest!
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Max and his excitement for a new quest in his favorite jungle.

slides.title: The Tall Tree
slides.text: Max found a very old, big tree. Its branches reached up to the sky. He looked up, up, up! He saw a tiny bright light. It was a Glow-Berry! The climb looked very, very long. Max felt a tiny bit unsure at first.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Max's initial hesitation when faced with the tall challenge.

slides.title: Max is Brave
slides.text: Max closed his eyes for a moment. He remembered his strong arms. He remembered his clever, helpful tail. He took a deep, brave breath. "I can do this!" he whispered to himself. Up he went, branch by branch. He moved carefully, but also very fast.
slides.speaker_notes: Illustrate Max gathering his courage and starting the climb with confidence.

slides.title: A Glowing Treasure
slides.text: Higher and higher Max climbed. The leaves tickled his nose. Soon, he reached the very top branch. There sat the Glow-Berry. It shimmered with soft, magical light. Max smiled a big, happy smile. He gently picked the special berry. What a wonderful find!
slides.speaker_notes: Show Max successfully reaching the Glow-Berry, feeling happy and proud.

slides.title: Happy and Confident
slides.text: Max climbed back down carefully. He held the Glow-Berry close. It felt warm in his hand. He felt so proud of himself. He did something tricky all by himself! Max knew he was brave and strong. His heart felt very warm and happy. He felt so confident now.
slides.speaker_notes: End with Max feeling proud and confident after his adventure.

instagram.caption: Max Monkey loves adventures! Today, he found a big, tall tree with a special Glow-Berry. It looked tricky to reach! But Max remembered how brave he is. With a deep breath, he started his climb. And guess what? He did it! This sweet story helps little ones feel confident and happy. Save for a warm read before naptime!
